term: being (ens), as the entity of a thing
definition: Being in the sense in which a thing is a being: the entity of a thing, as divided by the ten categories, convertible with 'thing'. In this sense no privation is a being, so evil is not a being. The Lean domain `Being` ranges over beings in this sense; nothing restricts it to bodies.
note: Lean locator: MotionModel.Being is the primitive carrier type, not the whole MotionModel or a predicate establishing which real things are beings. The chosen carrier interpretation is supplied by an application; neither existence nor the categorical reading follows from the field declaration alone. That applicability remains OPEN.
